days.top_line: Modi has declared victory over the Maoists in Bastar but says "this is not the end". UN climate talks open in Antalya, Turkey, on 9 November with modest goals.
Israel's President Herzog has asked Eisenkot to form the next government, but his alliance holds 48 of 120 seats. Meanwhile, US forces struck Iranian air defences while Trump talks of a deal.
The Sensex rose 2% for a seventh straight session as Korea and Japan fell 6% on fears of a US backlash against AI. In Paraguay, the lower house impeached President Peña after Ueno Bank collapsed.
The Supreme Court ruled that the 24-hour arrest clock starts when police first hold someone. Abroad, Trump is weighing a new attack on Iran as tankers hit mines near Hormuz, and AI stocks sold off.
Democrats won Congress. They can now block Trump's bills and investigate his officials, but they lack the two-thirds votes needed to override his veto or remove him. Oil fell nearly 9% as traders bet
Americans voted on 3 November 2026, but control of Congress was still unknown when we researched this. An Indian sailor was killed off Oman on 2 November when an aerial object hit his ship.
Iran has squeezed its ceasefire plan into two days, and a report says Netanyahu urged Trump to strike after 3 November. Americans vote in the midterms that day, but full results may take weeks.
Iran says Hormuz could reopen within two days if the US meets its conditions, while Trump threatens new strikes. Cyclone Murasu is expected to hit land near Ongole overnight.
